test_title: PYST 15: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triplets, each group of letters is related to the next group following a certain logic. From the given alternatives, select the one that follows the same logic.

KIND - NKID - DNIK

COST - SCOT - TSOC
solution:
The logic followed here is:

KIND - NKID - DNIK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c0928b351bc59545f42751c680bdca69cbdd64a50a62322e8fffae3673d4051.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3bbb93d16c22278a041f76306191f35c300fbe92f4ddab22902dcc637d4ba75.png] 

And,

COST - SCOT - TSOC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab5827ce5b10b17f66a00341f6ccc2fd4bdbf6fd27d4dd6a5fd8c11ebcada03f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a44f7b50839b5e14424fbc93259b82b76cdd89e77619090735341d46e2f7d557.png] 

Similarly,

FROM - OFRM - MORF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7631bab2afdb3e613e1ff3703d2bca81a34f188007fa6d474deec8147c8ed015.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a960783a386faecc77d262244b0f3c1a39e17b865d216e9c50e7cc84c4b8affa.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
